base_url.note: `url` on each page is already absolute — prefer it. `cdn` is jsDelivr: use it for anything that has to RENDER in a chat client, which commonly refuses raw.githubusercontent.com as an image source. `raw` is GitHub itself and is the freshest, but is better for fetching a file than for displaying one. jsDelivr edge-caches a changed file ~12 h; purge.jsdelivr.net forces it.
